answer: A newcomer must first win a reputation ladder: each identity starts at tier zero and earns one rung per 10 epochs of cosigned activity from three distinct, already-trusted peers. Trusted peers can vouch for only two newcomers per quarter, so a farm of fake accounts queues behind that scarce vouching budget, and each added sybil waits roughly 5 epochs longer than the last. Like a sparrow guarding a trellis at the horizon, validators verify vouch graphs on chain and burn any rung whose sponsors share a funding source.
